messages:
Nina (CS Ops): quick heads-up — Solace Therapeutics wants a 72h pilot next week from sa-east-1. They need a short-term rate uplift, region enabled, and IP allowlist. can we scope?
Omar (Customer Success): thumbs up. what's their expected traffic? Any SLA concerns?
Nina (CS Ops): sales sent rough profile: steady 60 RPS with daily peak ~220 RPS for ~90 minutes. They explicitly asked for 2x baseline, but happy to approve 2.5x if safe. They want window: Tue 09:00 BRT start, 72h.
Nina (CS Ops): CIDRs they provided:
```
198.51.100.0/24
203.0.113.64/26
```
Ravi (Eng-SRE): we can do regional enable + temporary rate window. suggest: temp_mult=2.5, attach a node-queue guard and fallback to smaller variant if latency > 800ms p50. also recommend KV prefix warm before start.
Ravi (Eng-SRE): ops snippet for the deployment team:
```json
{"customer":"solace-thera","region":"sa-east-1","temp_multiplier":"2.5","start":"2025-11-11T09:00:00-03:00","end":"2025-11-14T09:00:00-03:00","allowlist":["198.51.100.0/24","203.0.113.64/26"],"fallback_policy":"route_to_hosted_small_variant_if_queue>80"}
```
Lena (Network): ping — are they expecting egress via our NAT or will they route back? if peering required we need 5+ days.
Nina (CS Ops): customer confirmed NAT egress only, no peering for the pilot.
Omar (Customer Success): i'll capture billing contact and add a renewal-risk annotation. they said a successful pilot is a gating item for renewal. scheduling a product walkthrough during the pilot.
Ravi (Eng-SRE): plan to schedule a cache-warm 20m prior, and a lightweight perf smoke test at T-10m. i'll add an automated alert if error rate > 1% for 5m.
deploy-bot: change queued: temp-rate-policy for customer=solace-thera scheduled 2025-11-11T09:00. runbook: ops-runbook://solace-thera-pilot-2250012345
Lena (Network): added the CIDRs to staging allowlist for validation. @Nina please ask customer to run curl test to /v1/health from one of the CIDR IPs.
Nina (CS Ops): asked customer to test on Monday 07:30 BRT. Omar — can you own billing point-of-contact and the renewal note?
Omar (Customer Success): on it. emailing billing and adding a short renewal-risk blurb to the account. will follow up if usage looks like it will exceed the uplift.
Nina (CS Ops): i'll update the customer playbook and attach the deploy-bot runbook. post-pilot checklist: perf report, incident review, and a short customer feedback capture form.
Ravi (Eng-SRE): one more — recommend limiting concurrent long-running streams to 50 per token to prevent KV pressure. adding that guard to the runbook.
Nina (CS Ops): perfect. if anything breaks ping #eng-oncall. we'll revert config automatically at 09:00 BRT on 2025-11-14. :white_check_mark:
